description_en: Adds an instance whitelist. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
增加实例白名单
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: AddInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to create an IP/VPC whitelist
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The whitelist IP address or VPC ID. IP addresses are specified in CIDR block format
parameters.help_zh: 白名单IP或vpcId，IP以网段的形式设置
parameters.name: white_list_item

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type. If WhiteListItem contains IP addresses, set WhiteListType to 2. If WhiteListItem contains VPC IDs, set WhiteListType to 1.

VPC whitelists apply only to instances whose VPC access point is of the anytunnel type. The VPC access point of the latest version instances is of the privateLink type. Therefore, you cannot set VPC whitelists for such instances
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。
如果WhiteListItem中是IP类型，WhiteListType设置为2；如果WhiteListItem中设置vpcId，则WhiteListType设置1。

vpc白名单仅针对vpc接入点是anytunnel类型的实例。最新版本实例vpc接入点为privateLink类型，因此不能针对此种类型实例设置vpc白名单
parameters.name: white_list_type
